description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5970017076148 INSULATION SLEEVING: Line 0001 Qty 19 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0102 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
